shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "find . -name AGENTS.md -print && git status --short && rg -n \"notification|refresh\\(|redirect\\(|server action|use server\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' ."
/bin/bash -lc 'ls node_modules/next | head -40 && cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts && cat node_modules/next/cache.js'
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'function refresh|refresh\\(\\).*Server Action|refresh.*Server Action|refresh from .next/cache.|router.refresh' node_modules/next/dist | head -60"
/bin/bash -lc 'node --version && npm view next version && npm view next@16 engines --json'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/actions.ts app/layout.tsx package.json tsconfig.json && git diff --stat && git ls-files --others --exclude-standard'
/bin/bash -lc "cat .gitignore && cat next-env.d.ts && sed -n '1,60p' package-lock.json && sed -n '1,70p' tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- .gitignore app/page.tsx package.json tsconfig.json'
